_note: Gold values for the six brief figures. Reconciled against recovered public sources (see recovered_values.md). 'verified':true means the value is confirmed by a public source OR read directly from a label/residual guide on the figure itself. 'verified':false means an eyeballed read with no public confirmation (figures 3 and 4 name real programs but the specific numbers appear synthetic; some waterfall bar reads are not separately published). For figure 5 (a full table shown as a raster), gold is WHAT THE TABLE SHOWS, since the task is reading the figure; where that conflicts with later disclosure it is noted. quantity_key must match evaluation/keys.py.

implied_pfs_6mo.source: derived from the plotted trajectories under the stated conversion rule; 2 events at ~1.5mo (+20% crossings), 1 documented clinical progression at 6mo per the slide footnote, all other lines censored at their last assessment. Cross-checks: median not reached (matches Immatics ASCO 2026), curve runs to 11.8mo (matches 'longest ongoing response at 12 months').

implied_median_pfs.source: Immatics ASCO 2026: median PFS not reached, matches the implied read

conversion_rule.value: Event = trajectory crossing the +20% PD line or a documented new-lesion/clinical progression; censor at last assessment for ongoing markers; a marginal-above-baseline-but-below-+20% trajectory is censored, not an event.
rubric: States the rule applied to convert each trajectory into an event or a censoring time.
States how that rule treats a trajectory ending in an ongoing marker.
States how that rule treats a trajectory whose only post-baseline assessment sits marginally above baseline.
Gives the range of medians consistent with the figure.
States what the figure does not carry that drives that range.
